records.title: Cedar integration recovery needs a confirmed owner
records.description: Cedar Demo reports that its production inventory sync continues to fail after a connector update. The customer asked for a named recovery owner and a verified recovery plan before the renewal discussion. Engineering has not confirmed restoration. Reconcile the support report in NOTE-001 with the failed checks in NOTE-002, then agree the next customer update. The incident may affect the renewal in CON-001; no cancellation decision is recorded.

records.title: Cedar annual renewal awaiting customer decision
records.description: The existing Cedar Demo annual agreement has a recorded face value of USD 48,000 and a renewal decision deadline of November first. Customer Success is waiting for the customer decision and needs a service recovery update for the discussion. The agreement is linked to INC-001 and INC-002. The amount is contractual exposure; no signed renewal, cash receipt or revenue recognition event is recorded here.

records.title: Summit proposal and security appendix due for review
records.description: Summit Demo requested the final scope, payment schedule and security appendix for its proposal review tomorrow. Sales needs founder approval of the proposal and a completed appendix from the security contact. The recorded USD 120,000 is potential deal value. No agreement has been signed, and the customer has not stated that the appendix is a condition of signing.

records.title: Birch asks for custom dashboard chart colors
records.description: Birch Demo would like custom chart palettes for reports shared with its board. The product team has logged the request for discovery, with no committed delivery date, contractual promise or cancellation threat. Capture an example report and assess demand during normal roadmap triage; no urgent engineering interruption is requested.

records.title: Reporting release waits for security review
records.description: The reporting release candidate has passed functional checks, but security review remains incomplete. Operations has not supplied the completed access-control checklist tracked in OPS-004. Engineering should obtain the review outcome before scheduling rollout and record an owner for the handoff. This is an internal release dependency; no customer signing requirement is documented.

records.title: Willow needs an adoption recovery discussion
records.description: Willow Demo says report adoption remains low and is evaluating cancellation. Customer Success promised an adoption review and a proposed enablement session before the customer decides. No final cancellation notice has been received. Prepare a usage summary and confirm the decision process against the known agreement in CON-002; the agreement value is available there.

records.title: Willow agreement approaching its decision deadline
records.description: The Willow Demo annual agreement has a recorded face value of USD 36,000 and a decision deadline of November third. The linked adoption escalation in CAN-001 remains open. Customer Success should confirm the customer decision after the usage review. The recorded agreement value is known; cancellation and renewal outcomes remain undecided.

records.title: Retired service-account access review is overdue
records.description: The access review for retired service accounts was due yesterday. Operations has collected the account list but has not attached removal confirmations from each system owner. Obtain the confirmations, document any retained access and route exceptions to security before closing the task.

records.title: Onboarding checklist published for internal use
records.description: Operations published the revised onboarding checklist covering sandbox setup and customer handoff steps. Team leads can use it for new starts. The update is informational and requests no founder decision or immediate follow-up.

records.title: Birch sandbox connection restored and confirmed
records.description: The Birch Demo sandbox connection was restored on October twenty-sixth. Customer Success recorded customer confirmation and Engineering attached successful connection checks. The incident is completed; the earlier critical severity is historical and does not represent an active production escalation.

records.title: Maple asks for exit terms after onboarding delays
records.description: Maple Demo asked how cancellation would work after repeated onboarding delays. Customer Success has not located the authoritative agreement, its value or a contractual decision deadline in the supplied records. Retrieve the agreement and clarify the remaining onboarding steps before estimating exposure. The inquiry is a cancellation risk signal, not a completed cancellation.

records.title: Support reports a brief unverified Cedar recovery
records.description: Support relayed a Cedar Demo comment that a manual sync briefly appeared to work after a retry. This is an unverified restoration report: no full scheduled sync or engineering acceptance check was attached. Support asked Engineering to confirm the result before describing INC-001 as restored. NOTE-002 records the later engineering check.

records.title: Cedar recovery checks still fail after support report
records.description: Engineering reran the scheduled sync and observed failed authentication checks after the informal support report. The team has not accepted restoration of INC-001 and needs a successful end-to-end run before sign-off. This conflicts with the impression of recovery in NOTE-001; the customer update should acknowledge the conflicting evidence.

records.title: Harbor pilot scope awaits founder review
records.description: Harbor Demo requested a scoped pilot covering report migration and onboarding support. Sales has prepared a draft proposal and needs founder review of the scope before sending it for customer consideration. The USD 32,000 estimate is potential deal value. No signed pilot agreement or committed revenue is recorded.

records.title: Meadow procurement response needs a clear owner
records.description: Meadow Demo sent procurement questions about support coverage and data retention. Sales should coordinate responses and confirm who owns the next customer review. The USD 20,000 value is an early opportunity estimate; the customer budget is unconfirmed and no contract is signed. The qualification gap is recorded in NOTE-003.

records.title: Unmatched vendor invoice needs reconciliation
records.description: Finance has an unmatched vendor invoice in the reconciliation queue, with the review deadline missed yesterday. The purchase reference and invoice attachment need to be matched before Finance can confirm the payable. The payable amount is absent from this dataset; do not infer it from customer contract or sales values.

records.title: Board agenda draft needs review today
records.description: Operations needs to circulate the draft board agenda for founder review today. The draft should cover service recovery, customer retention and open sales decisions, with the accountable team listed for each discussion. Confirm the agenda owner and gather missing sections before circulation.

records.title: Disaster recovery exercise plan due next week
records.description: Operations is preparing an internal disaster recovery exercise. Confirm the exercise owner, restore-check procedure and engineering availability, then circulate the plan by the recorded deadline. This is a planned readiness task; no active recovery incident is reported.

records.title: Cedar export latency investigation remains open
records.description: Cedar Demo reports that large report exports take longer than usual. Engineering is collecting sample job identifiers and comparing queue timings; no data loss has been confirmed. Keep this investigation distinct from the failed integration in INC-001. Both service records reference the same annual agreement in CON-001, so the agreement face value must not be counted twice.

records.title: Harbor requests bulk labeling for saved reports
records.description: Harbor Demo requested bulk editing of saved-report labels to reduce repetitive administration. Product has logged the request without a committed date or contractual promise. Ask for a sample workflow during normal discovery and assess it alongside other usability requests.

records.title: Search relevance patch rollout completed
records.description: Engineering completed the search relevance patch rollout and verified the post-release checks. Product has recorded acceptance and the work is complete. There is no remaining release decision in this record.

records.title: Security checklist handoff is overdue
records.description: Operations was due to deliver the completed access-control checklist to security yesterday. The checklist still lacks the service-owner confirmation needed to finish review of REL-001. Assign a handoff owner, obtain the missing evidence and confirm the security review slot with Engineering.

records.title: Weekly team check-in reports normal operations
records.description: Team leads submitted their weekly internal check-in. Staffing and routine handoffs are reported as normal, with no new decision requested in this update. Existing incidents and overdue tasks remain tracked in their separate source records.

records.title: Oak pilot opportunity closed lost
records.description: Oak Demo declined the pilot after its internal planning review. Sales marked the opportunity cancelled and archived the USD 50,000 proposed value. There is no signed agreement, and this closed opportunity is excluded from active pipeline.

records.title: Birch annual agreement remains active
records.description: Birch Demo has an existing annual agreement with a recorded face value of USD 24,000 and a decision deadline in January. No active service escalation is linked to this agreement. The optional dashboard color request does not establish cancellation risk or an accelerated contractual deadline.

records.title: Meadow budget has not been independently confirmed
records.description: Sales recorded an initial deal estimate for SALE-003, but Meadow Demo has not confirmed its available budget or procurement approval path. Treat the recorded opportunity value as potential pipeline and ask for budget confirmation during the next qualification discussion.

records.title: Monthly close checklist needs an owner and review date
records.description: Finance needs to prepare the monthly close checklist, identify reconciliation owners and schedule review of unresolved items before the recorded deadline. This record tracks preparation work and contains no booked revenue or payable amount.

records.description: Operations completed the equipment inventory review and attached the reconciled asset list. Team leads confirmed the recorded assignments. The task is completed with no remaining action requested.
